clauses.clause: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a Basri planeswalker, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.evidence: The standard board has no Basri planeswalker and the probe never reaches a beginning of combat with the card out, so the trigger never appears in the trace ('the card has 1 triggered ability node(s)'; every stimulus gives none). Tree abilities[0] (identical to the compiler's own B2a-adherent-of-hope form): TurnPhaseEvent(COMBAT, actor you), intervening condition QTY_GE 1 over your planeswalkers with 'Basri' in the name, PUT_COUNTER one +1/+1 counter on this creature (IS_SOURCE). The Basri planeswalker is read by name (the pool's Basri planeswalkers, Basri Ket and Basri, Devoted Paladin, both have Basri in the name). Packs on the live tree: I08_1 (Basri Ket and your turn: exactly one counter on the Adherent only), I08_2 (Basri, Devoted Paladin also qualifies), I08_3 (Garruk, Unleashed, a non-Basri planeswalker, and the creature Basri's Lieutenant do not: no counter), I08_4 (the opponent's Basri: no counter), I08_5 (the opponent's turn: no counter), I08_6 (the Basri planeswalker leaves with the trigger on the stack: nothing on resolution, the intervening if is read again). Control, not ownership: I08_7 (a Basri Ket you gain control of qualifies), I08_8 (your own Basri Ket taken by the opponent does not). I08_9 (two Basri planeswalkers and two Adherents: each Adherent gets exactly one counter, on itself).
